body:
Well first off I would like to say that as I sit here my 'dose' continues to go up.  5 lines is what I have had before I began this report, but there is still a pile in front of me and I will continue to cut lines out as I feel necessary.
As an experienced drug user, with the exception of heroin, acid, and those 'crazy' drugs that I can't really get where I live (2-c-t-7, etc...) I have done just about everything and anything and in multiple amounts and combinations.  This is the first time I've submitted an experience online
, which I find to be
informative and useful substance.
Right now though I feel as if cocaine, which I have done multiple times, but it has probably been about a month or so since the last dosing (which I might say took place in NYC in combination with E, K, marijuana, and booze), is the most mind clearing drug out there, as well as the most addictive (as everyone says - it really is a 'do it once and you are hooked drug').
My mind goes from rampant and frequent thoughts about everything to being able to concentrate on one thing and focusing on what I feel is important at that time.  (BREAK FOR LINE)
It is one of the few drugs that I actually feel as if I can accomplish something while doing and feel proud of what I have done.  Although this is not always true, it is much more frequent then any other drug I have ever done.
Well, as I lean over to do another line before bed (since it is 4 AM - and I am one of those odd people that can actually fall asleep on cocaine, which many people can not do) I bid thee all farewell.  I know that my written experience here probably does not offer that much, but if it keeps one person from becoming an 'addict' then so be it and I'm happy.  Good night all!
